## Question 2

```{r}
library(aRtsy)
```

The Collatz conjecture starts with any positve integer `n`, if `n` is even, divide it by two; otherwise, multiply it by 3 and add 1. Repeats this process with the new `n` value. Eventually, `n` will reach to 1.

Let $f(n)$ be the next number obtained from $n$: $f(n)=\begin{cases}n/2,&\text{if }n/2 = 0,\\3n+1,&\text{if }n/2 = 1.\end{cases}$
